textSegments: Complies with ATX12V V2.4 & EPS12V V2.92
Semi Modular Design with Ribbon Cable
Complete Protections: OCP, OVP, SCP, OPP, OTP

FSP HYPER M85+ series of semi-modular ATX PSU feature excellent electrical performance, are 80 PLUS Bronze certified. HYPER M85+ units feature Japanese electrolytic capacitors with a full protection suite. The modular cable system assists with a clean installation and helps maximize airflow through your computer's case.
HYPER M85+ 650W not only comes with 80 PLUS bronze certified but also excesses the standard through its high efficiency up to 88%, 80 PLUS Silver certified.
DC to DC Module Design Provides Stable Power Outputs
HYPER M85+ series designed with DC-DC module are able to provide a consistent power source and good power conversion efficiency, which is the  right power for your needs.
The semi-modular ATX PSU with flat black ribbon cables makes installation fast and straightforward, with good-looking results and enhances airflow patterns inside the case.
120mm quiet fan and high ventilation- effect fan guard design makes HYPER M85+ spin quietly and keep cooling under maximum operation.
The high-quality Japanese E-capacitors can prolong product's life span by producing supreme stability and performance with low impedance characteristics.
OCP, OVP, SCP, OPP, UVP, OTP, a full guardian of circuit protections to keep hardware safe.
